name: Super Shuriken
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Shuriken is a free Math Game. Math is an ancient science that has helped us explore and understand reality for centuries. Ninja's are centuries-old martial-artists who practice ninjitsu. When you combine the martial artistry of ninja's with the legendary science of math you unleash an unstoppable force. In Super Shuriken you will play the role of a cartoon ninja who is solving mathematical equations as fast as they can in order to fire off their razor-sharp shuriken. The faster and more accurate your answers the more true your aim will be and thus your score will rise ever higher. You can use this game to sharpen your existing mathematical skills or learn new ones. Choose whichever skill-set you wish to work on and the different grade levels associated with them. You can choose from grades K-8 and within each grade, there are different skill types you can choose to challenge yourself. By combining math and ninjas, Super Shuriken makes learning and practicing the fundamentals of arithmetic an exercise in fun for the whole family.
